cues: Nepal passed through stage two between about nineteen fifty and nineteen ninety, which is why growth peaked.
Since then births have fallen fast: four point six children per woman in nineteen ninety six, two point one in twenty twenty two.
That is replacement level, and the reason for the slowdown in our cold open.
Education of girls is the single most effective control.
